text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Median income or consumption per month 1963 to 2024
Level of income or consumption per person per month below which 50% of the population falls. This data is
adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries. The chart shows breaks in the
comparability of the underlying household survey data over time within each country individually.

tspan.tspan: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)
This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured after taxes

text.tspan: and benefits) or to consumption, per capita.
